d:
The political battle in Raghunathpur Assembly constituency (Siwan district) is heating up as the RJD fields Osama Shahab, son of late Mohammad Shahabuddin, while the JDU has nominated Vikas Kumar Singh.
Chief Minister Nitish Kumar arrived in Raghunathpur to campaign for his party candidate — drawing huge crowds and strong reactions from locals.
In this exclusive ground report by Khabar Gaon, listen to what the people of Raghunathpur have to say about Nitish Kumar’s rally, Osama Shahab’s political entry, and the changing mood of Siwan ahead of the Bihar Assembly Election 2025.
